subject.title: [Feature]: Add description and enum to message tool's channel parameter

question: Should provider-oriented description text satisfy this issue, or must the message tool also expose a dynamically generated channel enum?
rationale: The description is a narrow proven repair, while enum support changes the model-facing schema contract and must account for dynamically registered channel plugins and aliases.

options.title: Land description only
options.body: Accept the linked PR’s focused guidance and test, then treat a plugin-derived enum as separate follow-up work if misuse continues.

options.title: Require dynamic enum
options.body: Expand the candidate to derive allowed values from the registered channel/plugin inventory with compatibility coverage for external plugins.

recommendation.title: Land description only
recommendation.body: Accept the linked PR’s focused guidance and test, then treat a plugin-derived enum as separate follow-up work if misuse continues.

likelyOwner.reason: They already reviewed this exact boundary and documented why description guidance is straightforward while enum support needs plugin-aware product judgment.
